died.name: Rudolf I of Germany
died.cause: he was buried at Speyer Cathedral
died.last_words: I am on the way to Spires to visit the kings, my predecessors.

died.name: James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth
died.desc: illegitimate son of Charles II of England
died.cause: to Jack Ketch, his executioner. Ketch was nervous and took several blows to behead Scott
died.last_words: There are six guineas for you, and do not hack me as you did my Lord Russell. I have heard that you struck him three or four times. My servant will give you more gold if you do your work well.

died.name: Anton Chekhov
died.last_words: It's a long time since I drank champagne.

died.name: Christine Chubbuck
died.cause: The 29-year-old American news anchor from Hudson, Ohio, shot herself in the head on live television at the start of Suncoast Digest, a local newscast for WXLT-TV in Sarasota, Florida, after reading some of the area's breaking news headlines. Chubbuck was the first person to take their own life on live television.

born.name: Charles Frohman
born.cause: paraphrasing Peter Pan prior to dying in the sinking of the RMS Lusitania
born.last_words: Why fear death? Death is only a beautiful adventure.

born.name: Ian Curtis
born.cause: written on a note before hanging himself
born.last_words: At this very moment, I wish I were dead. I just can't cope anymore.
